newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks hold strong gains to close higher.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks hold strong gains to close higher.

text.p: CHANGE CHANGE

* Toronto stocks held onto strong gains made by midday on Monday to end the day more than 50 points higher, powered by advances in large-capitalization issues.
Toronto stocks held onto strong early gains, driven up by interest in several large issues and a year-end portfolio shuffle at mutual funds, traders said.
The TSE 300 Composite Index rose 51.64 points to 5954.25 in brisk turnover of 763 million shares worth C$101 million.
Advancing stocks led declines 585 to 340 with 276 issues unchanged.
"I think it's people getting into the market before the January and February (retirement fund investment) rush comes along," said Fred Ketchen, senior vice-president of ScotiaMcLeod Inc.
Such large-cap issues as Potash Corp of Saskatchewan Inc, Imperial Oil Ltd, Thomson Corp and Bank of Nova Scotia shot higher in relatively brisk midafternoon trade on Monday.
Potash Corp was up 4.00 at 117.00, while Imperial added 1.65 to 64.40. Media and travel giant Thomson rose 1.65 to 30.50 and ScotiaBank appreciated 0.85 to 46.50.

The communications and media sub-group rose 240.60, or 2.42 percent, to 10202.54. Several stocks in the sector were given a boost after Merrill Lynch initiated coverage on a number of Canadian cable companies.
Falling interest rates in the United States and Canada over the past few sessions pumped up rate-sensitive sectors such as real estate, conglomerates and financial services.
--- STOCKS TO WATCH ---
* Merrill Lynch initiated coverage on Rogers Communications Inc with a near-term neutral rating and a long-term accumulate. Rogers shares rose to 9.95 before settling back to end 0.15 higher at 9.85.

Merrill started Shaw Communications and Groupe Videotron, both of them with a near and long-term accumulate rating. Shaw was edged up 0.05 at 7.75, while Videotron was up 0.30 at 10.80 in thin trade of only 400 shares.
-- ((Reuters Toronto Bureau 416 941-8100))
